title: Every new WO demo build opens the shared template picker, including legacy briefs
steps: Run the gallery picker E2E suite and WO client action/API suites.
On the local stand open Build demo from table, grid, inspector, details and selected rows; cancel each popup with all POST writes intercepted.
expect: Every entry opens the existing template picker before any build request.
Cancel creates no build; selected CMS/design/quickstart are forwarded explicitly.
Legacy brief build uses the place demo action with the entered site label; its old revision build door is never called.
Retry retains its original selection without opening the picker.
